entry.principles: Explore dignified, useful rooms, short circulation, daylight and privacy. Simple coherent massing, an inviting sheltered threshold and a legible roof can establish identity. Favor durable, repairable finishes and careful junctions over elaborate construction. A garden seat, porch or small shared outdoor room may enrich daily life. These are flexible inspirations, not requirements or price-derived promises.
entry.placement: Let the household brief, site, climate, privacy and architectural concept determine spatial relationships. Connect arrival, shared living and sheltered outdoor space where appropriate; separate guest, private and service movement when useful. No fixed floor areas, storey counts or room counts follow from the value label.
